subject: ML stack re-eval: renewal + capacity risk (Velocity AI)
messages:
From: Sara Dawson <sara@velocity.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Green <t.green@velocity.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal & capacity: vendor re-eval

Hi Rachel —

Quick note from Velocity: we’re coming up on our renewal for Q1 capacity and the infrastructure team surfaced a proposed switch to Asteria Cloud. They claim a 25% cost saving for our LLM inference footprint and are offering a migration credit.

Before we make any decisions we wanted to ask Redwood for a short independent benchmark and an ops plan that shows how you’d support the 3x seasonal spike we see in December. Can we get a performance + cost comparison and an ops runbook? Procurement also wants ballpark renewal pricing if we commit to a 12-month capacity increase.

We’re on a tight timeline — please let me know if you can run a micro-bakeoff with our sample workload this week.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Dawson
Head of ML Ops, Velocity AI
attachments: sample_payloads.tar.gz (stub)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Sara Dawson <sara@velocity.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity: vendor re-eval

Sara — thanks for the heads up and the sample payloads. We’ve seen Asteria’s public pricing — often good on headline $/token but with different burst/traffic economics.

Neha (AE) and Marcus (SE) — looping you both to run a quick micro-bakeoff and propose a save plan. Marcus — can you scope a test that mirrors Velocity’s December spike (3x) and include latency P95, cost per 1k tokens, and cold-start behavior?

We can also put together a Dedicated pilot + a one-time migration credit to demonstrate parity on cost and superior reliability. Neha — can you prepare a 12-month renewal offer and an optional capacity bump?

I’ll coordinate with Velocity once we have a short report.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Dawson <sara@velocity.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity: vendor re-eval

Thanks Rachel — draft test plan below. I attached benchmark-specs.yaml with the exact request schema.

Plan (summary):
- Workload: Velocity sample payloads (N=10k requests, mixed short/long prompts)
- Configs: Redwood hosted baseline (gpt-open-13b-q4), Redwood Dedicated (provisioned pool with prefix caching), Asteria config (as provided)
- Metrics: P50/P95 latency, tokens/sec throughput, inferred $/1k tokens (including caching), cold-start time, GPU utilization
- Run window: Oct 22–24 (off-hours for repeated stress runs)
- Deliverable: redwood_perf_report_v2.pdf and ops_runbook_v1.md (stub)

Attachments: benchmark-specs.yaml (test definitions)

Questions for Velocity: please confirm the December peak profile (req/sec) and whether you expect >95% short prompts (<=64 tokens) or a mixed distribution. That determines kernel selection and batching targets.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Dawson <sara@velocity.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Green <t.green@velocity.ai>, Velocity AI Procurement <procurement@velocity.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity: vendor re-eval

Marcus — thanks, confirmed the test window and attached the production sample set link (small subset to protect IP). December peak: average 4k req/sec for 6 hours; 70% short prompts (<=64 tokens), 30% long. Cold starts have been a pain with the current provider.

Tom asked if Redwood can guarantee a 99.9% availability SLA for the Dedicated pilot and include a simple escalation path. Procurement would also like to see renewal pricing and any migration incentives.

Sara

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Dawson <sara@velocity.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:26:00-08:00
Subject: Save plan + ops runbook for Velocity AI (pilot & renewal offer)

Sara / team — appreciate the test data. We completed the micro-bakeoff and attached the executive summary (redwood_perf_report_v2.pdf) plus a short ops runbook (ops_runbook_v1.md). Key takeaways:

- Performance: Redwood Dedicated matched Asteria on baseline throughput and improved P95 latency by ~18% on mixed workloads.
- Cost: nominal $/1k tokens was similar when accounting for Asteria burst fees; Redwood’s prefix/KV caching reduced effective token cost by ~12% for Velocity’s mix.
- Cold starts: Dedicated pilot with warmed pools reduced cold-start failures to <0.1% across runs.

Save offer (summary):
- 12-month renewal with a 20% capacity increase (to cover December peaks)
- 10% list discount on the committed capacity line item for the first 12 months
- One-month Dedicated pilot (no charge) + migration credit of $45k if contract signed by 2026-11-15
- 99.9% SLA for Dedicated pilot with a documented internal escalation path (see ops_runbook_v1.md)

Attachments: redwood_perf_report_v2.pdf (summary), ops_runbook_v1.md (runbook)

Next steps: procurement + legal will want the written term sheet and an updated quote. Neha — can you push a formal quote to procurement and include the migration credit language? Rachel — happy to join the procurement call to walk through the ops runbook.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sara Dawson <sara@velocity.ai>, Velocity AI Procurement <procurement@velocity.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:44:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Save plan + ops runbook for Velocity AI (pilot & renewal offer)

Team —

Velocity is positive on the report but procurement flagged the Asteria migration credit and wants an executive-level concession to keep the deal on Redwood. They asked if we can escalate a one-time commercial credit (additional $25k) or an extra month of Dedicated pilot to remove switching risk.

Neha — please prepare two formal term sheets: (A) current offer (10% discount + $45k migration credit) and (B) enhanced offer (10% discount + $70k total migration credit OR 2-month Dedicated pilot). Include standard T&Cs and a payment schedule.

Markus — can you sign off on margin impact if we do the $70k credit vs 2-month pilot? I want to move fast — procurement indicated a decision window of 72 hours after the term sheet.

I’ll be on the call with Velocity tomorrow at 11am PT. Monica / Marcus — please be available to answer ops and performance questions.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
